Aisha (sre): incident-bot: p95/p99 latency SLO alert fired for model-serving-prod in us-west-2. Automated paging to oncall.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #INC-4892 triggered (high latency SLO burn). Paging primary on-call: Marco.

Marco (eng-oncall): acking the page, looking now. any customer reports?

Dan (support): seeing uptick in customer errors in the dashboard, mostly timeouts from webhooks. CS triage opened: https://internal.redwood/cases/1287

Priya (platform): metrics: p95 jumped from 180ms -> 620ms, p99 ~ 1.8s across router pool A. CPU on node group a-rt-1 at 90%. KV-cache evictions trending up.

Aisha (sre): confirmed: autoscaler hasn't spun extra replicas for ~7m due to quota limit on GPUs in us-west-2 (quota consumption spike).

Marco (eng-oncall): taking ownership. steps: 1) escalate PD to infra team for quota bump or temporary burst. 2) shift low-priority routes to cheaper model variant. 3) enable local request shedding for non-SL tier.

Marco (eng-oncall): @Priya can you run a quick node spin up (manual) while I open infra incident?

Priya (platform): starting a manual scale to add 3 extra workers in us-west-2. Command run: ```kubectl scale deployment model-serving --replicas=42 -n production --context=west2```

Priya (platform): also applying a temporary GKE node pool increase: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize us-west2-pool --size 10`

incident-bot: Update: autoscaler attempted scale but hit quota error: `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Insufficient GPUs in region`

Marco (eng-oncall): opening infra PD: INC-4893, paging infra-oncall. @pagerduty-bot please escalate to infra-primary if no ack in 2m.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation created for INC-4893.

Aisha (sre): mitigation: enable per-customer rate limits for bulk ingest endpoints to reduce tail amplification. Patch applied to gateway: `max_concurrency=8` for /ingest/batch.

Dan (support): notifying top 3 affected customers, advising degraded throughput, ETA unknown. Template message sent, case attached.

Marco (eng-oncall): We should failover traffic from router pool A to pool B (lower latency but lower throughput). @Priya can you flip the router weight?

Priya (platform): adjusting traffic weights: ```curl -X POST https://router.internal/weights -d '{"A":0.2,"B":0.8}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'``` Applying now.

Marco (eng-oncall): after weight shift, p95 improved to ~340ms, p99 ~900ms. Still degraded but much better.

Aisha (sre): KV cache hitrate dropped from 96% -> 72%, contributing to increased compute ops. Suggest warming key prefixes for common prompts.

Marco (eng-oncall): quick warm script run: ```python tools/warm_cache.py --namespace=prod --keys-file=top_prompts.txt``` Warmed ~18k keys.

Priya (platform): manual nodes are coming up, but GPU quotas are still the gating factor for full autoscale. Infra team on INC-4893 acknowledged and requested region redistribution or temporary quota increase from cloud provider.

pagerduty-bot: INC-4893 acknowledged by infra-oncall (Ravi).

Ravi (infra, via pagerduty): mid-incident: requesting permission to temporarily redirect some reserved capacity from staging to prod. Need approval from SRE lead.

Aisha (sre): I approve temporary reassign of 2 reserved GPUs from staging pool (low risk) to prod. Proceed.

Priya (platform): done. Node pool reflecting extra GPUs; autoscaler now able to create 6 machines. Observability: p99 down to 420ms within 90s.

Dan (support): customers reporting lower error rates. I'm marking cases as 'watching'.

Marco (eng-oncall): good. next: we'll keep autoscale rules aggressive for 15m, then step down. Also schedule a canary de-dup of small batch requests.

Aisha (sre): summary for postmortem: root cause = regional GPU quota exhaustion during a traffic spike plus cascading KV cache thrash. Contributing: autoscaler didn't have the cross-region fallback enabled. Impact: elevated p95/p99 for ~18m, several customer timeouts (incidents opened).

Marco (eng-oncall): handoff to night on-call in 30m. I'll prepare a short runbook in the incident channel and slice of dashboards.

Marco (eng-oncall): runbook draft: - current mitigations: traffic shift A->B, manual node add, temporary reserved GPU reassign, cache warm, request-shedding for non-SL tiers. - monitoring: watch p95, p99, KV cache hitrate, node pool GPU utilization. - rollback: if p99>1.5s for 5m, re-open PD and escalate to SEs for model-variant fallback.

Priya (platform): creating a short ops-run for handoff: https://internal.redwood/runs/ops/4892-handoff

Dan (support): will keep customers updated with next ETA in 15m.

pagerduty-bot: INC-4892 auto-resolved (latency reduced below threshold). Incident remains for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident update: severity downgraded to SEV-3. Postmortem owners requested: Aisha, Priya, Marco.

Aisha (sre): assigning postmortem ticket PM-277. Initial timeline and mitigation steps documented.

Marco (eng-oncall): handing off to @night-oncall (Lina) in 30m. Lina: please monitor p99 and confirm autoscaler stable. If any re-burn, do immediate rollback to model-variant low-cost route.

Lina (night-oncall): ack. I'll be on watch and will page if anything reoccurs.

Dan (support): closing loop: customers notified, cases set to monitoring.

Aisha (sre): thanks team. After-action items: 1) enable cross-region fallback in autoscaler, 2) add proactive quota-monitoring alert, 3) pre-warm KV cache during morning traffic ramp, 4) document reserved GPU playbook.

Marco (eng-oncall): adding those to the postmortem. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
